name: Calculator

screenshots.caption: A calculator that takes the devices' wattage from their entries
A solar payback calculator on a whiteboard, next to sticky notes

description: A ```calc block for pages and whiteboards: inputs and formulas, one line per value ("Label (unit) = number, formula or @entry.attribute"). Readers change the inputs and see the results at once, nothing is saved; inputs bound to an entry take its attribute from the knowledge graph. Formulas know + - * / ^ %, & for text, comparisons and SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, ROUND, CEIL, FLOOR, ABS, SQRT and IF.

blocks.example:
title: Power cost of the NAS
Power (W) = 25
Electricity price (€/kWh) = 0.32
Hours per day (h) = 24
Cost per year (€) = Power * Hours_per_day * 365 / 1000 * Electricity_price
Cost per month (€) = Cost_per_year / 12
